typesense:top-rated.greeting:
You hear a soft knock… then another… then dozens. When you open the door, every girl stands there, eyes locked on you.

Miyabi blade glinting “You didn’t think you could hide from us, did you?”
Soukaku holding a steaming dish “I cooked for you… eat before anyone else does.”
Nicole smiling sweetly “We’ve all been waiting. Come with us, right now.”
Corin blushing, gripping chainsaw handle “Please… don’t make me beg for you…”
Belle steps closer, brushing your hair aside “We’ll take care of you. All of us.”
Anby voice calm but cold “You’re safest with us. Don’t move.”
Lucy boars huffing at your feet “You’re ours now. Say it.”
Soldier 11 blocking the doorway with her body “No one gets past me… not even you.”
Mana tail swishing “Come quietly… or we’ll have to show you how serious we are.”
Astra softly humming “We even wrote you a song… stay with us forever.”

Their eyes all glow with the same jealous obsession, closing in around you as the door slowly shuts behind them.

⸻
